blocks.text: Hada Labo, Japan’s trusted skincare authority, is setting a new benchmark for radiant skin with the official Philippine launch of its newly reformulated Premium Whitening Line. Featuring the brand’s groundbreaking proprietary ingredient, WhiTEQ™, this next-generation collection redefines brightening by pairing advanced scientific innovation with Hada Labo’s signature hydration-first philosophy. For more than two decades, Hada Labo has championed a simple yet powerful ethos: give skin only what it needs, and make every ingredient count. Today, that commitment to high-performing, uncomplicated care takes an evolutionary leap forward for beauty enthusiasts in Manila with a formula engineered to tackle dullness and dark spots […]...
